problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a differentiable convex function f: ℝᵈ → ℝ. A global minimizer x★ exists with ‖x0−x★‖≤R and f(x0)−f(x★)≤Δ. Strong convexity is not required.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Each query x returns exactly ∇f(x), for every history and oracle seed. Function values are not supplied. Algorithms may randomize and use arbitrary adaptive query points.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: spec.admissible, HasGradientAt condition; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexKnownGapPolynomialDimension.lean: spec.Query and spec.Reply; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm, Setup.allowedAlgorithm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient is differentiable everywhere and satisfies ‖D(∇f)(x)‖≤L0+L1‖∇f(x)‖ globally, with L0,L1>0. A globally Lipschitz gradient is not required.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: spec.admissible, Differentiable and fderiv conditions; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexKnownGapPolynomialDimension.lean: spec.valid.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Euclidean geometry on ℝᵈ. Writing a=√(L0R²/ε) and b=L1R, the dimension must satisfy d≥⌈2⁴⁶(1+b+a)⁶⌉.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All parameters d,L0,L1,x0,R,Δ,ε are public; f is accessed through the oracle. Known radius and initial-gap bounds hold for a common minimizer. The parameter regime requires R,ε>0, L0R²≥16ε, b=L1R≥2²⁰, and Δ≥ε max{(2+b)²,√(L0R²/ε)}.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexKnownGapPolynomialDimension.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a point x̂∈ℝᵈ whose objective gap relative to a global minimizer is integrable and satisfies E[f(x̂)−f(x★)]≤ε. No last-iterate or queried-point output restriction is imposed.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Accuracy is in expectation over the algorithm and oracle seed laws, under a fixed cap on total gradient queries. No almost-sure objective-gap guarantee is required.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Convex optimization with exact gradients is standard, but this setup combines gradient-dependent curvature, a public initial-gap bound, and explicit parameter-dependent polynomial dimension and accuracy restrictions.
